items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Pig Meat Markham with his act, Vivian Harris... I used to just get in that wing and sit there and listen at them do that cause I had a lot of fun with them.

ctx.x: If you'd just finish that sentence where you were talking about, what, Pig Meat, then we'll stop cause we don't want to get you too close.
Right. When I, Pig Meat Markham with his act, Vivian Harris (inaudible). They had a beautiful act. Here Come The Judge. I used to just get in that wing and sit there

and listen at them do that cause I had a lot of fun with them. I always had to have some kind of comedy on my show cause I liked to sit up there and enjoy myself too while the show was going on. Every show I had some kind of comedy. Dusty Fletcher, "Open The Door, Richard". Remember the time?
